attempts.repair_feedback_detail: error type and message; method-order errors can name missing tool methods but never include expected arguments or output values

execution.infrastructure_error_policy: an unrecovered provider error stops the run; resume at the first unwritten row with --start N and a new --output file, preserving the original request keys
execution.temperature_note: not set: Claude 4.7 and later reject a non-default temperature

tools.source: Agent Management tool library, attached to both variations

execution.tool_loop_step_limit_source: launchdarkly_ai_claude_messages handler _MAX_STEPS; BFCL's own harness allows 20
execution.system_message: Use the available tools to complete the user's requests.
execution.system_message_note: required: the AI SDK will not load a completion variation without at least one message; BFCL's native function-calling harness sends none
execution.tool_keys: lowercase; BFCL's ten camelCase vehicle functions use snake_case keys (lock_doors runs lockDoors)
execution.timeout_note: Anthropic Python SDK default; the runners do not override it
execution.retry_note: Anthropic Python SDK default: 2 automatic retries on connection errors, 408, 409, 429, and 5xx. Retry time counts toward task duration.

reproducibility.sdk_upgrade_policy: a run on a newer lock is a new protocol version
